metadata.title: Boundary Geometry Determines Optimal Shallow ReLU Approximation under Weighted Coefficient Constraints
metadata.abstract: We study how boundary geometry affects $L^q$ approximation by shallow ReLU neural networks on convex bodies $K\subset\mathbb R^d$. The target classes are unit balls of weighted variation spaces that can enlarge classical spaces by incorporating domain geometry into constraints on output coefficients. We establish upper and lower bounds for arbitrary convex bodies and determine the optimal polynomial approximation exponents for all planar convex bodies and their products with polytopes, including cubes and circular cylinders. For $C^2$ convex bodies, we determine the optimal exponents in a dimension-dependent range of $q$ extending beyond $2$. When all principal curvatures are positive, the result extends to every finite $q\ge2$. For these classes, the dependence of the optimal exponent on the domain is captured by a single geometric growth exponent associated with small boundary caps. We also identify sharp weight thresholds for retaining the classical approximation exponent and improve previous weights on Euclidean balls while preserving the classical $L^2$ approximation rate. When the target is given as a finite ReLU network, the upper bounds can be realized by a compressed network using only the original neurons, without increasing the weighted coefficient sum. These results show that boundary geometry can change the optimal exponent even when dimension, error norm, and weighting rule are fixed.

analysis.progressType: 边界几何控制加权 ReLU 逼近率
analysis.workSummary: 研究凸体上浅层 ReLU 网络对加权变差空间单位球的 Lq 逼近，权将域边界几何纳入输出系数约束。对任意凸体给上下界，确定所有平面凸体及其与多面体乘积的最优多项式指数；C² 凸体在依赖维数、超出 q=2 的范围内确定最优指数，主曲率全正时覆盖每个有限 q≥2。指数依赖由小边界帽的单一几何增长指数描述；另给保持经典逼近率的尖锐权阈值，并证明有限网络可仅保留原神经元压缩且不增加加权系数和。
analysis.breakthrough: 展示相同维数、误差范数和权规则下，边界几何仍能改变最优逼近指数。
analysis.limitations: C² 情形的 q 范围有维数限制，覆盖全部有限 q≥2 需所有主曲率正；最优指数不等于确定全部常数或端点对数因子。研究神经网络本身不代表作者使用生成式 AI。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。PDF 全 92 页提取完整且无短文本页，全文检索未观察到作者使用生成式 AI 的披露。浅层 ReLU 神经网络是本篇研究对象，不能因此判断作者用了生成式模型。

analysis.priorityReason: 与凸几何和近似论交叉明显，但本站以几何分析和曲率为优先，因此中等优先级。
